identity.title: [v0.92][ADR 0065][207.a] Reconcile terminal ACIP schema catalog evidence

values.goal: Reconcile terminal evidence for ADR 0065 without promoting or accepting the ADR.
values.required_outcome: An issue-local evidence packet states whether ADR 0065 has terminal, landed, exact-revision-bound ACIP schema catalog and governed projection proof, with residual gaps recorded for #207 and #288.
authority_boundary: #283 consumes terminal evidence only; it does not own ACIP implementation or proof repair
#5832 remains historical/superseded evidence unless current terminal authority explicitly restores it
#209 / PR #215 may serve as replacement proof only if live merge, derived terminal cache, non-empty artifacts, and validation manifests agree
#288 owns shared ADR index, plan, manifest, and review packet serialization
No ADR may be moved to Accepted by #283
operator_constraints: Do not edit shared ADR docs, ADR index, milestone plan, or product code
Use typed C-SDLC v2 for lifecycle state
Use raw GitHub only for read-only observation if typed GitHub state is insufficient
Preserve root main cleanliness and bind execution to a FastWork worktree before implementation edits
